items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: The interviewer asks 'Yeah, Charlene' likely referring to the street name 'Charlize' (Charlene Street) which the interviewee corrects/clarifies as part of the location description.

ctx.x: He'll get it open. We'll stop it. I'm going to take one of those people. I wanted to ask you, we better stop it for a second.
I wanted to ask you where you were born. Yeah, Charlene. What, you know what street you were born on?

Uh, down, down in the French course at, uh, on St. Mary, uh, uh, by the, by the, between, uh, uh, Espenade, uh, on Decatur between, uh, uh, Charlize and, uh, I mean, on the trail between Espanade and Barracks.
